title: Hungarian Forint: Key 360 area supports consolidation against Euro – Societe Generale
summary: Societe Generale analysts describe EUR/HUF as consolidating above the 360 area after an interim low near 348 in June. The pair is capped by the 200-day moving average at 370/371, with a breakout above this zone needed to confirm a larger up-move.

title: Gold steadies on Iran diplomacy hopes, Fed outlook caps upside
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) halts its intraday decline on Tuesday as traders weigh fresh Middle East headlines while the broader geopolitical backdrop remains tense. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,315, after bouncing from a low of $4,291 during European trading hours.

title: Japanese Yen: Overbought rally faces 158.40 cap – UOB
summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/JPY remains supported after testing the 157.30 area, with short-term price action expected to stay within a 156.90–157.80 range.
